question: Compare reflection at a spherical mirror and refraction at a plane surface in terms of change in direction of light. Give reason why reflection does not change the medium of propagation, while refraction does.

options.A: In reflection, light enters another medium and its speed changes; in refraction, it stays in the same medium.
options.B: Reflection and refraction both keep light in the same medium, so its speed never changes.
options.C: Reflection occurs because light changes medium, while refraction is the return of light from a surface.
options.D: At a spherical mirror, light reflects back into the same medium, so its speed remains unchanged although its direction changes. At a plane refracting surface, light transmits into another medium of different refractive index, so its speed and generally its direction change.
